components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis action in a section.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{min-height:44px;padding:12px 20px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:var(--accent,#2f6ba8);color:#fff;font:600 14px/1 IBM Plex Sans,sans-serif;transition:background 180ms,box-shadow 180ms}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--accent-hover,#27598c)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#2f6ba8) 35%,transparent);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet alternate route such as the CV download.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{min-height:44px;padding:12px 20px;border:1px solid var(--line-soft,#d9d7d1);border-radius:999px;background:var(--surface-1,#fff);color:var(--text-1,#19191b);font:600 14px/1 IBM Plex Sans,sans-serif;transition:border-color 180ms,background 180ms}.ds-btn-secondary:hover{border-color:var(--accent,#2f6ba8);background:var(--surface-2,#f0efeb)}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#2f6ba8) 35%,transparent);outline-offset:3px}

components.css: .ds-project{padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--line-soft,#d9d7d1);border-radius:20px;background:var(--surface-1,#fff);color:var(--text-1,#19191b)}.ds-project-media{aspect-ratio:16/10;margin-bottom:24px;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--surface-2,#f0efeb),var(--accent,#2f6ba8));box-shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(20,24,31,.12)}.ds-project p{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--text-2,#66656b);font:500 13px/1.3 IBM Plex Sans,sans-serif}.ds-project h3{margin:0 0 16px;font:600 24px/1.2 IBM Plex Sans,sans-serif}.ds-project a{color:var(--accent,#2f6ba8);font-weight:600}.ds-project a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#2f6ba8) 35%,transparent);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A quiet contact field with a visible focus state.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:8px;color:var(--text-1,#19191b);font:500 14px/1.3 IBM Plex Sans,sans-serif}.ds-field input{min-height:48px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line-soft,#d9d7d1);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface-1,#fff);color:var(--text-1,#19191b);font:400 16px/1.4 IBM Plex Sans,sans-serif}.ds-field input:focus{border-color:var(--accent,#2f6ba8);outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#2f6ba8) 25%,transparent)}

components.name: Section Navigation
components.description: Normal-case navigation that reads as language, not machine metadata.
components.html: WorkExperienceContact
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:20px;font:500 14px/1.3 IBM Plex Sans,sans-serif}.ds-nav a{min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;color:var(--text-2,#66656b);text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a.is-active{color:var(--text-1,#19191b)}.ds-nav a.is-active{box-shadow:inset 0 -2px var(--accent,#2f6ba8)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#2f6ba8) 35%,transparent);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: A concise personal casebook where real product screens and clear technical decisions carry the identity. The surrounding interface stays quiet, sober and approachable.
keyCharacteristics: Product evidence before biography or stack inventories.
Warm neutral surfaces with one accessible cobalt accent.
Large sans-serif hierarchy and authentic monospace only.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Cobalt carries interaction; screenshots carry personality.

rules.name: The Mono Must Be True Rule
rules.body: If text is not code, a command or machine output, it uses the sans family.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Components must read correctly without a shadow.

dos: Show Strev, SaveMyMoneyNow and Atalaya through real screens or authentic output.
Place selected work immediately after the compact hero on mobile.
Keep Anuubis Solutions in the experience timeline and GitHub company field only.
donts: Do not reuse fleet counters, server metrics, monitoring signals or decorative status dots.
Do not build the identity from neon gradients, badge walls, fake consoles or stack slogans.
Do not present internal Anuubis tools or client operations as Alex's projects.
